test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.

My parents have been __lying__ to me since I was a kid.
solution:
The correct sentence is **'Option 4' **i.e. **'Misleading'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate synonym for the underlined word 'lying' in this context is:** "misleading"**
 
• In the given sentence, **'lying'** refers to the act of intentionally providing false information.
 
• Therefore,** "misleading", **which also means to lead someone in the wrong direction or into a mistaken action or belief often by deliberate deceit, is an appropriate synonym.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Misleading'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options aren't correct:
 
 
• **"Framing" **can mean to construct or compose something, to falsely incriminate someone, or to position something visually (as in a picture frame). None of these meanings fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Stopping" **means to cease moving or to bring to a halt, which isn't related to lying.
 
• **"Crying"** refers to the act of shedding tears, usually due to emotional distress, and doesn't fit as a synonym for lying.
